text: Implemented the cross-compiled scalafim-fmri-workflow foundation. Added pure typed StudyAnalysisSpec, DatasetRecipe, ModelRecipe, ContrastWorkflow, GroupWorkflow, StudyCatalog, FirstLevelUnit/RunInput, ResultBundleRef/output policy, exhaustive PreflightReport, deterministic SubjectJob/GroupJob construction, and ChunkProgram fan-out. Plans contain artifact references and immutable recipes, not readers, open handles, voxel payloads, scheduler state, or captured execution functions. Wired build/root aliases and updated README/module ownership docs. Verification: sbt fmriWorkflowJVM/test passed 8/8; sbt fmriWorkflowJS/test passed 8/8; shared source scan found no JVM/platform imports; no lower module imports fmri-workflow; scoped git diff --check and trailing-whitespace scan are clean.
